name: Dark Lands
pages: Lands of Darkness/Depths are entirely composed of deepslate.$(br)This property naturally extends to any and all structures that may generate.$(br2)The underground contains iron, gold, and diamond ores, alongside amethyst geodes.

Some rare sculk may grow on the surface, while the underground is mostly infected.$(br)This may even affect some of the deeper dungeons.$(br)Just try not to trigger the Sculk Shriekers. Wardens can spawn even on the surface.
